definitions.gloss: start of the rainy season; onset of tsuyu
definitions.explanation: The official beginning of the rainy season (梅雨) in Japan, typically announced by the Japan Meteorological Agency around early to mid June. Marks the transition into weeks of frequent rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入梅|にゅうばい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}かった→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: The start of the rainy season was earlier than usual this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入梅|にゅうばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Japan Meteorological Agency announced the start of the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {入梅|にゅうばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}き→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧にくく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{除湿機|じょしつき}→除湿機：06492_joshitsuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}して→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Once the rainy season starts, laundry has trouble drying, so you should have a dehumidifier ready.

notes:
Composed of {入|にゅう} (entering) + {梅|ばい} (plum), short for ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season). The rainy season is called ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ because it coincides with the ripening of plums (⟦{梅|うめ}→梅：01869_ume⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入梅|にゅうばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to enter the rainy season
- {入梅|にゅうばい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: the time of rainy season onset
- {入梅|にゅうばい}⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧: official rainy season declaration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{梅雨入|つゆい}り→梅雨入り：08337_tsuyuiri⟧: start of the rainy season — the more common everyday expression with the same meaning
- ⟦{梅雨明|つゆあ}け→梅雨明け：08338_tsuyuake⟧: end of the rainy season — the opposite, marking when the rains stop
- ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧: rainy season — the season itself

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {入梅|にゅうばい} announcement is a major seasonal event in Japan, heavily covered by news media. It typically occurs in early June in the south (Okinawa can be as early as May) and progressively later moving north. Hokkaido generally does not have a distinct rainy season.
